columns.comment: First day of the cost month.
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Last calendar day of the month.
columns.name: month_end_date

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year as its starting calendar year (FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: fiscal_year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label, e.g. FY2026 (Apr 2026 - Mar 2027).
columns.name: fiscal_year_label

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Product family the cost is allocated to: Corporate Lending, Cash, Liquidity, Payments, Trade Finance or FX.
columns.name: product_family

columns.comment: Direct product cost in USD for the month (share of the coverage cost base driven by the product).
columns.name: direct_cost_usd

columns.comment: Relationship-manager coverage cost in USD for the month.
columns.name: rm_cost_usd

columns.comment: Operations cost in USD for the month: account upkeep on deposit families, payment processing on Payments.
columns.name: operations_cost_usd

columns.comment: Head-office overhead allocation in USD for the month.
columns.name: ho_allocation_usd

columns.comment: Total allocated cost (opex) in USD = direct + RM + operations + HO. Additive.
columns.name: total_cost_usd

columns.comment: Revenue of the same client, month and family in USD (product feeds) - denominator of the cost / income ratio.
columns.name: total_revenue_usd

columns.comment: Source finance records (client references) summed into the row - more than 1 when entity resolution merged records.
columns.name: n_source_records

columns.comment: True when the cost belongs to a credit relationship whose quarterly cost ties to the relationship P&L cost to serve.
columns.name: is_pnl_reconciled

comment: Cost to serve allocated to each golden client, product family and month (Apr-2024 to Sep-2026, Client Profitability): direct product cost, relationship-manager cost, operations cost (account upkeep, payment processing) and head-office allocation, in USD, with the same line's revenue for cost / income ratios (SUM(total_cost_usd) / SUM(total_revenue_usd)). Costs are monthly flows: additive across months, families and clients. For credit relationships the quarterly totals tie to the cost to serve of the relationship P&L. Grain: one row per golden client x month x product family.
